_readme: The measured inputs of 48-platform-cost.md's ladder (lane/d-platform-cost, 2026-11-21). Aggregates only: no account, hero or session.
Seconds are PRODUCTION database-seconds. REAL = production read (tools/balance-program/platform-cost.local.mjs, 2026-11-21 07:00-08:00 UTC,
pg_stat_statements since 2026-10-31 13:42, 20.74 days, 40,015 s). MEASURED = this lane's replay runs (platform-cost.mjs profile/window/aged).
ESTIMATED = arithmetic on both, with the method in `why`. node tools/balance-program/platform-cost.mjs ladder prints the tables.

why.awayCommitsAnHour: REAL commits: 36.0 a hero-hour away at every party size, 14 days
why.watchedCommitsAnHour: REAL commits: 200.8 a four-hour watched (181 lone, 198 three)
why.closedCommitS: ESTIMATED. A commit with no client open builds no frame and no projection (hr_frame_wanted, character_presence 75 s). Four: the 2027-03-31 note's arithmetic (192 ms = 4 projections of 42 + a core of about 24) and this lane's REAL minute buckets (a four's away commit with its tab open +206 to +242 ms = core + read + 4 frames) put read + core at 40 to 80 ms; 55 central. Lone: the replay's lone/four ratio (65/177 PGlite ms) x 55
why.watched.pollMs: REAL means: the settle read 19.1-24.4 ms, hr_seed+perks 2.17, the hello's six reads 21 ms a call x 1.6 calls a poll, hr_state_of 48 ms on 0.6 early asks a poll
why.watched.commitMs: core ESTIMATED (above, without the read); projection REAL hr_state_of 48 ms; frames 3 members x 42 ms (2027-03-31 note, REAL then)
why.watched.offscreenLoadSAnHour: REAL hr_load 109-111 ms x 3 off-screen heroes x 60 an hour (28): gone with lane/c-server-cost (L01)
why.watched.residualSAnHour: REAL minus the model: a watched four-hour is +107 to +119 s over an empty minute (capacity sample, 305 minutes); the settle path, the off-screen load and the polls explain 77.6. UNATTRIBUTED
why.townHeroHourS: REAL: 46 town settles a town hero-hour (75,395 settles / 1,626 h) x (hr_tick_settle 2.45 calls x 18.6 ms + the visit's whole-character hr_state_of 0.84 x 48 ms + perks and seed 4 ms) = 90 ms a settle
why.townTabHourS: REAL x MEASURED (28): a tab standing in town alone, 660 calls an hour
why.pressS: REAL: hr_apply 59.6 ms + the state its answer carries 48 ms
why.fixedSADay: REAL (28): cron that runs whoever plays

L13.why: MEASURED share: journal inserts and the day-budget reads, 5 to 10% of a commit on the replay (aged 0 to 4,500 rows today: +4 ms)

C10.why: MEASURED: the same 20 minutes committed every 100 s and every 600 s end IDENTICAL; a 600 s commit costs 1.0 to 1.3 times a 100 s one (Krell four 48.6 -> 62.2 PGlite ms)

P1.why: ESTIMATED: the settle read's per-row calls (512 hr_hunt_setup_live, 991 hr_hunt_limit, 15,710 hr_skill_curve rows for a four) are 60% of the replay's read; production's read is 20 of 55 ms

TCF.why: 59: 3 statements a job, 2 jobs a hero a day, 20 ms each

L07.why: 59: 20 presses a day after Carry on and the plans

L24.why: 28's ASSUMED x4 on every whole-character read
